fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge width/depth adequacy against real crossing demand (bus stop plus service-road junction on wide A4019 arms) is a classic, substantive Stage 1 RSA issue affecting whether users can wait safely clear of traffic.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is anchored by verbatim quote EV-UK-015 ('not wide enough to safely house a cyclist... could be clipped by vehicles') supplemented by a recorded assumption citing RSA response report Table 4-1; no invented geometry asserted since drawings were not sighted.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a categorical safety concern under GG 119 Stage 1 scope with no compliance claim or normative basis asserted, and no mixing of compliance and safety questions.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: deliverable refuge depth/width sized for a defined user group (expectant parent with pushchair plus cycle) at identified locations (each A4019 crossing adjacent the bus stop), viable to action at detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly the affected road users, with pushchair users called out in the recommendation, so VRU impacts are fully considered rather than merely acknowledged.

justifications.substance: Confirming adopted large-vehicle swept paths remain valid after stop-line repositioning is substantive at Stage 1, particularly since the cited assessment already notes limited over-run into opposing lanes.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim that swept-path envelopes exist for the refuse vehicle and 7.5t box van is supported by the verbatim EV-UK-002 quote; stop-line proximity relies on recorded scheme facts referenced in the scenario rather than invention.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as compliance_question with null risk components and an explicit scoping note, keeping the confirmation request categorically distinct from an asserted GG 119 safety problem.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: re-run large-vehicle swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions, gated before Stage 2, giving a clear owner action and timing.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists, central refuges, and desire lines are acknowledged with an explicit statement that no VRU-specific exposure is asserted here, matching the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.
